verses.sanskrit: वैशंपायन उवाच। ततः संप्रस्थितो राजा कौन्तेयो भूरिदक्षिणः। अगस्त्याश्रममासाद्य दुर्जयायामुवास ह॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Then the of Kunti, the king (Yudhishthira), distinguished for his large gifts, son came to the hermitage of Agastya and lived at Durjaya.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव लोमशं राजा पप्रच्छ वदतां वरः। अगस्त्येनेह वातापिः किमर्थमुपशामितः॥२॥
verses.english: That foremost of eloquent men, the king (Yudhishthira) asked Agastya why Vatapi was killed there by him,

verses.sanskrit: आसीद्वा किंप्रभावश्च स दैत्यो मानवान्तकः। किमर्थं चोदितो मन्युरगस्त्यस्य महात्मनः॥३॥
verses.english: And what was the prowess of that meneating Daitya and why the anger of that highsouled (Rishi) was excited against him.

verses.sanskrit: लोमश उवाच। इल्वलो नाम दैतेय आसीत्कौरवनन्दना। मणिमत्यां पुरि पुरा वातापिस्तस्य चानुजः॥४॥
verses.english: Lomasha said: O descendant of Kuru, there was a Daitya, named Ilvala in the days of yore in the city of Manimati. He had a younger brother, called Vatapi.

verses.sanskrit: स ब्राह्मणं तपोयुक्तमुवाच दितिनन्दनः। पुत्रं मे भगवानेकमिन्द्रतुल्यं प्रयच्छतु॥५॥
verses.english: That son of Diti (one day) spoke to an ascetic Brahmana, (saying), “O exalted one, give me a son equal to Indra.”

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै स ब्राह्मणो नादात्पुत्रं वासवसंमितम्। चुक्रोध सोसुरस्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्य ततो भृशम्॥६॥
verses.english: As that Brahmana did not give him a son equal to Indra, that Asura got exceedingly angry against that Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र इल्वलो ब्रह्महाऽसुरः। मन्युमान्भ्रातरं छागं मायावी ह्यकरोत्ततः॥७॥
verses.english: O king of kings, from that day the Asura Ilvala became a destroyer of Brahmanas. Endued as he was with the power of illusion, he made his brother a goat.

verses.sanskrit: मेषरूपी च वातापिः कामरूप्यभवत्क्षणात्। संस्कृत्य च भोजयति ततो विप्रं जिधांसति॥८॥
verses.english: Vatapi who was capable of assuming any form at will at once assumed the form of a goat. After being cooked that food was given to the Brahmanas in order to kill them.

verses.sanskrit: स चाह्वयति यं वाचा गतं वैवस्वतक्षयम्। स पुनर्देहमास्थाय जीवन्स्म प्रत्यदृश्यत॥९॥
verses.english: For he, whom he (Ilvala) summoned with his voice, would at once come back to him if he had gone even to the abode of Yama.
verses.bhavadeepa: कामरूपी यथाकामं रूपाणि कर्तुं समर्थः संस्कृत्य पक्त्वा ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: ततो वातापिमसुरं छागं कृत्वा सुसंस्कृतम्। तं ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्वा पुनरेव समाह्वयत्॥१०॥
verses.english: Thus having transformed Vatapi into a goat and after having cooked his flesh, he fed the Brahmanas and summoned him (back) again.

verses.sanskrit: तामिल्वलेन महता स्वरेण वाचमीरिताम्। श्रुत्वातिमायो बालवान्क्षिप्रं ब्राह्मणकण्टकः॥११॥
verses.english: That powerful (Asura) endued with great power of illusion, that thorn to the Brahmanas, hearing the words loudly uttered by Ilvala,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पार्श्वं विनिर्भिद्य ब्राह्मणस्य महासुरः। वातापिः प्रहसन्राजन्निश्चक्राम विशांपते॥१२॥
verses.english: That great Asura Vatapi, O king, O ruler of earth, would laughingly come out ripping open the sides of these Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स ब्राह्मणान्राजन्भोजयित्वा पुनःपुनः। हिंसयामायस दैतेय इल्वलो दुष्टचेतनः॥१३॥
verses.english: O king, having thus fed the Brahmanas again and again, the wicked-minded Daitya Ilvala destroyed the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यश्चापि भगवानेतस्मिन्काल एव तु। पितॄन्ददर्श गर्ते वै लम्बमानानधोमुखान्॥१४॥
verses.english: The exalted Agastya in the mean-while saw his (dead) ancestors hanging in a pit with their head downwards.

verses.sanskrit: सोपृच्छल्लम्बमानांस्तान्भगवन्तश्च कम्पिताः। संतानहेतोरिति ते प्रत्यूचुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः॥१५॥
verses.english: He asked them who were thus hanging, "What is the matter with you?" And those Brahmanas replied, “It is for the want offspring.”

verses.sanskrit: ते तस्मै कथयामासुर्वयं ते पितरः स्वकाः। गर्तमेतमनुप्राप्ता लम्बामः प्रसवार्थिनः॥१६॥
verses.english: They told him, “We are your forefathers. We are thus hanging in this pit for the want of offspring.
verses.bhavadeepa: सोऽपृच्छदिति । तान् भवं लम्बमानेन रूपेण तेषामुद्भवम् अपृच्छत् । पृच्छतिर्द्विकर्मा । किमर्थं यूयं लम्बध्वमित्यपृच्छदित्यर्थः । ते ऋषयः कम्पिता इव सन्तस्ते तव सन्तानहेतोरयमस्माकं भव इति प्रत्यूचुरिति सम्बन्धः ॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: यदि नो जनयेथास्त्वमगस्त्यापत्यमुत्तमम्। स्यान्नोऽस्मान्निरयान्मोक्षस्त्वं च पुत्राप्नुया गतिम्॥१७॥
verses.english: O Agastya, if you beget an excellent son for us, we may then be saved from this hell and you too can acquire the blessed state obtainable by begetting offspring."

verses.sanskrit: स तानुवाच तेजस्वी सत्यधर्मपरायणः। करिष्ये पितरः कामं व्येतु वो मानसो ज्वरः॥१८॥
verses.english: To them replied that powerful Rishi observant of truth and morality, "O Pitris. I shall accomplish your desire and remove the fever of your mind.”

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसवसन्तानं चिन्तयन्भगवानृषिः। आत्मनः प्रसवस्यार्थे नापश्यत्सदृशीं स्त्रियम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Then that illustrious Rishi began to think how to perpetuate his race. He did not find a fit wife in whom he can take his birth as his son.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्य तस्य सत्त्वस्य तत्तदङ्गमनुत्तमम्। संगृह्य तत्समैरङ्गैर्निर्ममे स्त्रियमुत्तमाम्॥२०॥
verses.english: He then, taking those parts of creatures that are considered beautiful, created an excellent woman with them.

verses.sanskrit: स तां विदर्भराजाय पुत्रार्थं तप्यतस्तपः। निर्मितामात्मनोर्थाय मुनिः प्रादान्महातपाः॥२१॥
verses.english: That greatly ascetic Rishi then gave that woman created for him to the king of Vidarbha who was performing great asceticism to beget an offspring.
verses.bhavadeepa: तस्य तस्य सिंहमृगादेः अङ्गं कटिदृष्ट्यादि । सर्वगुणवतीमित्यर्थः ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: सा तत्र जज्ञे सुभगा विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा। विभ्राजमाना वपुषा व्यवर्धत शुभानना॥२२॥
verses.english: Taking her birth there, that exalted girl of beautiful face, as effulgent as the lightning, began to grow in body day after day.

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रां च तां दृष्ट्वा वैदर्भः पृथिवीपतिः। प्रहर्षेण द्विजातिभ्यो न्यवेदयत भारत॥२३॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, as soon as she was born, seeing her, that ruler of earth, the king of Vidharbha communicated it to the Brahmanas in great joy.
verses.bhavadeepa: जज्ञे जाता । सौदामनीति विशेष्यम् । विद्युदिति विशेषणं द्युतिविशेषोपपादनार्थम् । कुर्यां हरस्यापि पिनाकपाणेर्धैर्यच्युतिं के मम धन्विनोन्ये' इत्यादौ पिनाकपाणिपदम् ऊर्जितचापवत्त्वद्योतनार्थमुपक्षीणं सन्न विशेष्यसमर्पणायालमिति हरस्येति पृथक्प्रयुक्तं तद्वदिहापि ध्येयम् ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यनन्दन्त तां सर्वे ब्राह्मणा वसुधाधिप। लोपामुद्रेति तस्याश्च चक्रिरे नाम ते द्विजाः॥२४॥
verses.english: O ruler of earth, all those Brahmanas blessed her and those twice born ones gave her the name of Lopamudra.

verses.sanskrit: ववृधे सा महाराज बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम्। अप्स्विवोत्पलिनी शीघ्रमग्नेरिव शिखा शुभा॥२५॥
verses.english: O king, possessed with great beauty that blessed girl began to grow quickly like a lotus in water or the blazing flame in a fire.
verses.bhavadeepa: मुद्राणां तत्तन्मृगादिजातिगतानामसाधारणानां चिह्नानां कमनीयचक्षुष्ट्वादीनां लोप इव लोपस्तिरस्कारो यया सा लोपामुद्रा । आहिताग्न्यादिवत्पूर्वनिपातः । अन्येष्वपि दृश्यन्त इति दीर्घः । प्रकारान्तरेण योगे तु वेदे पदपाठलोप आमुद्रेत्यवग्रहः स्यात्स च न दृश्यते त उक्तविधैव व्युत्पत्तिर्युक्ता ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: तां यौवनस्थां राजेन्द्र शतं कन्याः स्वलंकृताः। दास्यः शतं च कल्याणीमुपातस्थुर्वशानुगाः॥२६॥
verses.english: O king of kings, when she grew youthful, one hundred damsels adorned with ornaments and also one hundred maid-servants, remaining at her command always, waited upon that blessed girl.

verses.sanskrit: सा स्म दासीशतवृता मध्ये कन्याशतस्य च। आस्ते तेजस्विनी कन्या रोहिणीव दिवि प्रभा॥२७॥
verses.english: Surrounded by these one hundred maidservants and remaining in the midst of these one hundred damsels, that effulgent damsel shone, as the brilliant Rohini (star) in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: यौवनस्थामपि च तां शीलाचारसमन्विताम्। न वव्रे पुरुषः कश्चिद्भयात्तस्य महात्मनः॥२८॥
verses.english: When she grew youthful, even then for the fear of the illustrious king none dared ask for her hand, endued as she was with good and excellent manners.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु सत्यवती कन्या रूपेणाप्सरसोप्यति। तोषयामास पितरं शीलेन स्वजनं तथा॥२९॥
verses.english: That truthful maiden possessed of beauty like that of an Apsara pleased her father and relatives with her good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: वैदर्भीं तु तथायुक्तां युवतीं प्रेक्ष्य वै पिता। मनसा चिन्तयामास कस्मै दद्यामिमां सुताम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Seeing her attain to puberty, her father, the king of Vidharbha thought in his mind, "To whom shall I give my this daughter?”
